# PCIe Subsystem Clock/Reset Verification Plan

## 1. Clock Sources

| # | Source | Description | Freq | Evidence |
|---|--------|-------------|------|----------|
| C1 | External PAD | 100MHz differential clock input to chip; feeds PHY ref clock + CRG PLL | 100 MHz | §3.1 p16; §1.15 p9 |
| C2 | CRG PLL (functional) | Built-in PLL in CRG; generates AMBA bus root clock; ref from PHY 100MHz (normal) or ref_clk 20MHz (test/debug) | 1 GHz max | §1.15 p9; §3.1 p16 |
| C3 | CRG PLL (test) | Test mode PLL output | 2 GHz max | §1.15 p9 (1501) |
| C4 | PHY ref clock chain | PHY0 gets 100MHz diff from PAD; PHY1/2/3 daisy-chain from prior PHY | 100 MHz | §1.12 p8 (1203) |

**Derived Clocks** from CRG (§1.15 p9-10, 1504-1506):

| Clock | Frequency | Role |
|-------|-----------|------|
| `axi_clk` | 1 GHz | AMBA bus clock |
| `cr_para_clk` | 125 MHz | CR parallel interface clock |
| `local_phy_ref_clk` | 100 MHz | PHY reference clock |
| `max_pclk` | 1 GHz (lane0) | Controller logic clock; divided to `core_clk` / `pclk` per lane rate |

**Clock Modes** (§4.15.5 p37):
- **CC** (Common Clock) — supported
- **SRIS/SRNS** (Separate Clock) — supported; L0s disabled when SRIS active

**Low Power Clock** (§4.12.3.4 p33):
- L1 Clock PM: PLL + reference clock may be shut down during L1 (non-substates)
- `CLKREQ#` PAD controls reference clock gating during L1 SubState (§4.17 p38)

---

## 2. PLL/CRG/GFM/DIV/MUX Roles

| Module | Role | Evidence |
|--------|------|----------|
| **PLL** (in CRG) | Generates root AMBA clock; dual ref source (20MHz test / 100MHz normal); 1GHz functional, 2GHz test max | §1.15 p9; §3.1 p16 |
| **CRG** (Clock Reset Generator) | Central clock+reset manager: generates core/AMBA/PIPE/LP clocks; manages power-on, warm, LP partial resets | §3.1 p16; Figure 4-1 p21 |
| **GFM** (Global Clock Manager) | Receives CRG outputs; distributes clocks/resets to different chip domains (downstream of CRG) | Figure 4-1 p21 (VLM desc) |
| **DIV** (in Controller) | Divides 1GHz `max_pclk` (lane0) to `core_clk` and `pclk` per actual lane rate | §1.15 p10 (1506) |
| **MUX** (in CRG PLL ref) | Selects between `ref_clk` 20MHz (test/debug) and PHY co-sourced 100MHz (normal) | §1.15 p9 (1502,1503) |

**Architecture flow**: External 100MHz PAD → CRG (PLL → DIV/MUX network) → GFM → domain clocks
- Figure 4-1 (p21): `clk_ref` → CRG → `clk_out` / `reset_out` → GFM → domain distribution

---

## 3. Reset Sources

| Reset | Trigger | Scope | PCIe Subsystem Behavior | Evidence |
|-------|---------|-------|------------------------|----------|
| **Cold Reset** (Power-On) | External PAD asserts `power_on_rst_n` | **Entire chip** | Full re-initialization to initial state | §4.5.2 p23; §3.1 p16 |
| **Warm Reset** | Host pulls `PERST#` low; tied to `power_on_rst_n` | **Entire chip** + PCIe | Full chip reset; must re-establish link after PERST# deassertion | §4.5.2 p23; §4.17 p38-39 |
